newsitem.title: USA: HHL Financial Services files for Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: HHL Financial Services files for Chapter 11.

text.p: HHL Financial Services Inc and two affiliates on Monday filed for Chapter 11 protection in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware.
In court papers, the company listed assets of $31.0 million and liabilities of $67.4 million. Also filing were Professional Data Services Inc and CredAmerica Inc.
HHL Financial is based in Woodbury, New York, and in court papers described its business as healthcare accounts, receivables management, and collection.
The case has been assigned to Judge Sue Robinson of the U.S. District Court of Delaware.
